field_desc.APP_NAME: Internal application name used across the platform.
field_desc.APP_TITLE: Title shown in the browser tab and UI header.
field_desc.LOG_LEVEL: Root logging verbosity. Applied immediately on save.
field_desc.LYNDRIX_UI_ENGINE: Which UI engine core serves. “react”/“both” require the built React bundle. Takes effect on restart.
field_desc.DEFAULT_LOCALE: BCP-47 language tag used when a user has no preference (e.g. en, de).
field_desc.SUPPORTED_LOCALES: Comma-separated list of locales offered in the language switcher.
field_desc.THEME_DB_OVERRIDES_ENABLED: Allow theme overrides stored in the database to take effect.
field_desc.DEFAULT_THEME_ID: Identifier of the theme applied by default.
field_desc.LYNDRIX_PLUGINS_DESIRED: Comma-separated plugin specs reconciled on boot: https://github.com/org/repo[@version].
field_desc.LYNDRIX_PLUGINS_AUTO_UPDATE: Automatically update installed plugins to the latest version on restart.
field_desc.LYNDRIX_PLUGIN_COLLECTION_URL: Git URL of the plugin collection/registry used by the marketplace.
